newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - PaineWebber ups Danish 1996 GDP, CPI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - PaineWebber ups Danish 1996 GDP, CPI.

text.p: In its latest survey U.S. investment bank PaineWebber on Tuesday raised its expectations for Denmark's 1996 GDP (groos domestic product) growth to 1.8 percent from 1.7 percent in its last forecast in September.
At the same time it upped its 1996 forecast for inflation to 2.2 percent from 2.1 percent, leaving its estimate for the current account surplus at an unchanged 8.1 billion crowns.

The latest Danish Econony Ministry forecast in October foresaw 2.0 percent GDP growth, 2.1 percent inflation, 8.9 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 10.3 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
